question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>{</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>}</mo></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>{</mo><mo>(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>∈</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>×</mo><mi>A</mi></math> : <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>b</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>|</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>|</mo></math> or <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="}" open=""><mrow><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> be a relation on <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>A</mi></math>. Then the minimum number of elements, that must be added to the relation <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi></math> so that it becomes reflexive and symmetric, is

solution.text:
Given,

A={-4,-3,-2,0,1,3,4} and R={(a,b)∈A×A : b=|a| or b2=a+1 be a relation on A,

So, the relation is given by,

R={(-4,4),(-3,3),(0,0),(1,1),(3,3),(4,4),(0,1),(3,-2)}

Now, relation to be reflexive (a,a)∈R ∀ a∈A

⇒(-4,-4),(-3,-3),(-2,-2) also should be added in R.

Now relation to be symmetric if (a,b)∈R, then (b,a)∈R ∀ a,b∈A

⇒(4,-4),(3,-3),(1,0),(-2,3) also should be added in R

Hence, minimum number of elements to be added to
R=3+4=7
